description: Find the cheapest travel dates around a target date. Shows a calendar view of minimum prices for flexible date travelers.

daysAfter.description: Number of days after the target date to include (default: 7)

daysBefore.description: Number of days before the target date to include (default: 7)

destination.description: IATA airport code for arrival (e.g. LAX)

origin.description: IATA airport code for departure (e.g. JFK)

targetDate.description: Center date for the calendar search (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: search_calendar
